description: This class includes the manufacture of motor vehicles for transporting persons or freight.
includes: manufacture of lorries, trucks and road tractors for semi-trailers
manufacture of motor vehicles for transporting goods
manufacture of special purpose motor vehicles: ambulances, fire engines, snowploughs, street sweepers, mobile laboratories, mobile medical units
manufacture of engines for motor vehicles
excludes: manufacture of bodies for motor vehicles, see 2920
manufacture of parts and accessories for motor vehicles, see 2930
maintenance and repair of motor vehicles, see 4520
